summary: Fenbo Holdings Limited, a Cayman Islands company filing Form 6-K, reported results of its July 31, 2026 class A and class B shareholder meetings and extraordinary general meeting. Shareholders approved two special resolutions: increasing class B voting rights from 20 to 200 votes per share, and adopting amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. Class A holders voted 1,111,498 for and 3,594 against the voting rights change; class B holders voted unanimously. This is a routine governance and charter amendment matter, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms apply; watch for potential control implications of the enhanced class B voting power.
